name: 92647 · Huntingtn Bch, CA
findings: ZIP 92647 (Huntingtn Bch) has 175 nonprofit organizations. 53 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92647 (Huntingtn Bch) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
32% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
